title: Aurora: a foundation model for the atmosphere
summary: A 1.3-billion-parameter model for high-resolution weather and air-pollution forecasting: it matches or exceeds CAMS on 74% of targets and matches or beats GraphCast on 94%. The roughly 5,000-fold speedup over the IFS system is an estimate; GraphCast remains slightly better on specific humidity, at most pressure levels up to five days.

evidence.tested: Forecasts were compared with CAMS for air pollution (Jun-Nov 2022, matched or beat 74% of targets) and with GraphCast (matched or beat 94% of targets) over 2022 evaluation periods.
evidence.unknown: GraphCast was slightly better on specific humidity at most pressure levels up to five days, and the page has no dedicated limitations section.
evidence.ai_role: A 1.3-billion-parameter foundation model, pretrained on over a million hours of simulations, forecasts weather and air pollution at 0.1 degrees.
